title: The Abandoned Kennel
text: Hounds in rusted iron cages, their ribs like the bars that hold them. Left behind by some old lord's hunt, forgotten when the horns faded. They whine at the sight of you, a dry scrape of sound from throats gone raw with thirst.

options.label: Break the cages open and feed them.

outcomes.text: Their exuberance for those who fed them bolsters the spirits of the ones who set them free.

options.label: Take the finest of them home, to run at your heel.

outcomes.text: The finest of them, all bone and hunger, is already loyal. It runs at its rescuer's heel, scenting trouble long before anyone sees it.
The howling follows you a long way, thinner and thinner, until you cannot tell if you still hear it.
